title: The Dark Truth About Code Geass: Akito the Exiled #Shorts
description:
What culture calls destiny in Code Geass: Akito the Exiled is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. Code Geass: Akito the Exiled (Japanese: コードギアス 亡国のアキト, Hepburn: Kōdo Giasu: Bōkoku no Akito) is a Japanese anime original video animation (OVA) series and a spin-off to the main Code Geass series. The five episode OVA originated from Sunrise's desire to produce a new work related to the franchise with Akane taking the director role despite his inexperience with it.

The bleak reading of Code Geass: Akito the Exiled is also the most testable one. Originally intended to be released in four chapters, production of a fifth Akito the Exiled episode was announced after the Japanese debut of the third entry on May 2, 2015.Madman Entertainment has also released the first three episodes on DVD. On March 15, 2017, Funimation officially announced the pre-order and release date, June 27, 2017.
